maddeler.e:
يحبوا (form I)
# يَحِبُّوا (yaḥibbū) /ja.ħib.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# يُحَبُّوا (yuḥabbū) /ju.ħab.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# يَحُبُّوا (yaḥubbū) /ja.ħub.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# يَحَبُّ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
